question:
**Select the option that can be used as a one-word substitute for the given group of words.**

The murder of a king
solution:
The correct answer is '**Regicide**'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The most appropriate word for the given group of words is '**Regicide**'.
 
• **Regicide**: a person who kills or takes part in killing a king. (वह व्यक्ति जो किसी राजा की हत्या करता है या हत्या में भाग लेता है।)
 
 
• *Example: The 55th anniversary of one such **regicide** passed three days ago.*

 
 
 

**Correct Answer:__** *Regicide.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• Let's look at the meaning of other words:
 
 
• **Sacrilege**: treating a religious object or place without the respect that it deserves. (पवित्र वस्‍तु या स्‍थान का अपमान; अपवित्रीकरण)
 
• **Rebel**: a person who fights against his/her country’s government because he/she wants things to change. [राजद्रोही; सत्ता-विरोधी व्‍यक्ति (परिवर्तन की इच्‍छा से राज्‍य-शासन से संघर्ष करने वाला व्‍यक्ति)]
 
• **Reticule**: a woman's small handbag, typically having a drawstring and decorated with embroidery or beading. (एक महिला का छोटा हैंडबैग, जिसमें आमतौर पर एक डोरी होती है और कढ़ाई या बीडिंग से सजाया जाता है।)
